title: Quick Roasted Brazilian Yautia Skewers
description: A Whole30-friendly Brazilian dish featuring yautia, perfect for a quick and easy meal prep, wrapped in banana leaves for added flavor and fun presentation.

ingredients.name: yautia
ingredients.notes: also known as malanga or taro root

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Peel and chop the yautia into 1-inch cubes.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut oil, lime juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the yautia cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cut the banana leaves into large squares, about 6 inches per side.
Thread 4-5 yautia cubes onto each banana leaf square, leaving a small space between each cube.
Fold the banana leaves over the yautia to form a packet and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Place the packets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the yautia is tender and lightly browned.
Remove the packets from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
